parsed.rationale: The two computed properties `HSBColor.uiColor` (line 53) and `HSBColor.nsColor` (line 63) in `Shared/ColorPalette/Sources/ColorPalette/HSBColor.swift` are structurally similar (Jaccard 0.71) because they both convert the same `HSBColor` value type to a platform color, but they target distinct platform types — `UIColor` (UIKit/iOS) and `NSColor` (AppKit/macOS) respectively. These are intentionally parallel platform-specific conversions; collapsing them into a single generic or shared implementation would require conditional compilation or type erasure that adds complexity without removing meaningful duplication. No restraint markers are present, but the domain concepts are genuinely distinct: one is an iOS surface, the other a macOS surface, and their structural similarity is a natural consequence of wrapping the same HSB components for two different frameworks.
